preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.
The number of edges m is at least n-1 and at most the minimum of n(n-1)/2 and 200,000.
The value k is between 1 and the minimum of n(n-1)/2 and 400 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y and 1 <= w <= 10**9 for x, y, w in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the valid range with a positive integer weight up to 10^9.
The number of provided edges matches m.
The graph formed by the edges is connected.

postconditions.description: The output integer is the k-th element (1-based index) of the sorted list of all pairwise shortest path distances d[i][j] where 1 <= i < j <= n.
The list of shortest paths contains exactly n(n-1)/2 elements, corresponding to all unique pairs of distinct vertices.

postconditions.expression: all(sorted_shortest_paths[i] <= sorted_shortest_paths[i+1] for i in range(len(sorted_shortest_paths) - 1))
postconditions.description: The list of shortest paths is sorted in non-decreasing order.
